title: Inventory Vault
subtitle: Secure Asset Management System
description: Laravel 11 inventory management application with CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention via Eloquent ORM, XSS escaping, and Bcrypt password hashing.
problem: Web applications need security built in, not bolted on. Every input must be validated, every session protected, every query parameterized.
approach: Built a full-stack inventory system using Laravel 11 with security-first design: CSRF tokens on all forms, Eloquent ORM for SQL injection prevention, XSS escaping, Bcrypt password hashing, and secure session management.
results: Functional inventory management system with CRUD operations, multi-tagging system, dynamic filtering, and comprehensive security controls against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
